components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-button-primary { padding: 13px 18px; border-radius: 14px; border: 1px solid rgba(215, 124, 255, 0.35); background: linear-gradient(90deg, #7c2cff, #d77cff); color: #f7f0ff; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: filter 180ms ease, opacity 180ms ease, transform 180ms ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(124, 44, 255, 0.18); } .ds-button-primary:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.52; filter: grayscale(0.25); }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Dark filled field for operational creation flows.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 13px 15px; border-radius: 14px; border: 1px solid rgba(195, 132, 255, 0.22); background: rgba(12, 4, 28, 0.84); color: #f7f0ff; outline: none; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgba(216, 205, 236, 0.58); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: rgba(215, 124, 255, 0.65); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(124, 44, 255, 0.18); }

narrative.overview: Donnée OS is a dark internal command surface for operational consulting work. It should feel premium, focused and slightly experimental, but the visual system must serve repeated use rather than spectacle.
keyCharacteristics: Purple-black tonal depth with rare bright accents.
Glass-like panels used as a deliberate brand material.
Responsive shell that preserves navigation and operational context.

rules.name: The Signal Rarity Rule
rules.body: Bright violet and magenta are operational signals. Use them for active navigation, metrics, primary actions and status emphasis, not as general decoration.

rules.name: The Dark Console Rule
rules.body: Screens should stay dark and focused. Light surfaces, white dashboards and blue enterprise themes are off-brand.

rules.name: The Dense Clarity Rule
rules.body: Typography must stay compact inside operational panels. Reserve large type for page-level orientation only.

rules.name: The Purposeful Glass Rule
rules.body: Glassmorphism is part of Donnée's identity here, but it must remain tied to real containers, not decorative floating cards.

dos: Do keep new screens inside the existing app shell, content, page-header, panel, row and form-row conventions.
Do pull statuses and priorities from metadata endpoints when available.
Do preserve the dark premium purple-black workspace.
Do use violet and magenta as operational signals, not background filler.
Do keep forms compact, readable and responsive.
donts: Don't make Donnée OS look like a default Bootstrap admin panel.
Don't use generic SaaS template composition or CRM clone layouts.
Don't introduce bright corporate blue dashboards or flat white enterprise tables.
Don't add advanced AI, automation, billing, finance, ERP or complex workflow engines unless explicitly requested.
Don't use decorative effects that do not improve operational clarity.
